CORAM :
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  OR % 14.08.2024 CRL.M.A. 24232/2024 (Exemption)
1. Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of, accordingly.
CRL.M.A. 24231/2024 (For stay)
1. The proceedings emanating of the FIR be stayed till the next date of hearing.

2. Application stands dispose of, accordingly.
1.

This petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No. 574/2019 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC PS Sagarpur, Delhi on the basis of a settlement arrived at through a divorce deed/khula/talaknama dated 04 th February, 2023, which is on record of this Court.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/08/2024 at 08:23:21 2.
Counsel for the petitioner states that a notice may have to be issued to respondent No.2/complainant as she is not voluntarily present.

3. Accordingly, Court Notice be issued through the IO to respondent No.2/complainant to be present in Court on the next date of hearing.
4.
List on 26th September, 2024.
